strings.conditions.editor.library_note: Library conditions are reusable building blocks stored as JSON files. They can be referenced by other conditions, but they are never applied directly to workbench rows.

strings.equipment.no_addons_warning: This item has no armor add-ons, so Skyrim Vanity System cannot use it for DAVE row or override variants.
strings.help.gear.1: Use this tab to override a specific equipped gear piece.
strings.help.gear.2: Browse individual armor pieces from the equipment catalog.
strings.help.gear.3: Double-click to add an override using Skyrim Vanity System's default target selection, or use the context menu to add a new workbench row instead.
strings.help.outfits.1: Browse full outfits from plugins in the catalog.
strings.help.outfits.2: Double-click to replace matching row overrides so the result matches the preview. The context menu also offers the old append behavior, or you can add the outfit as workbench rows instead.
strings.help.kits.1: Browse Mod Explorer kits loaded from data/interface/modex/user/kits.
strings.help.kits.2: Kits behave like outfits: double-click replaces matching row overrides so the result matches the preview. The context menu can apply a kit with a specific condition, offers the old append behavior, can add rows to the workbench, and can delete kits.
strings.help.kits.3: Kits that refer to non-existent items are not shown.
strings.help.slots.1: Use this tab to override a specific equipment slot no matter which armor you have equipped there, as long as something is equipped in that slot.
strings.help.slots.2: Browse slot-based overrides that target armor addon slots.
strings.help.slots.3: Armor addons are sub-components of an armor, and Dynamic Armor Variants Extended resolves slot overrides against the union of those addon slots rather than only the slots declared on the armor form itself.
strings.help.slots.4: Double-click to add a slot row to the workbench, or use the context menu to add it manually.
strings.help.conditions.1: Use this tab to define reusable condition sets for Dynamic Armor Variants Extended.
strings.help.conditions.2: Conditions are built from condition functions joined by AND and OR operators, plus a shared display color so you can recognize them later.
strings.help.conditions.3: Double-click a condition to edit it, use Add New to create a fresh one, or drag a condition to a workbench row so that row only applies when the condition is met.
strings.help.host_toggle.docked: Pop the catalog back into the main window.
strings.help.host_toggle.popout: Pop the catalog out into its own window.
strings.help.show_all_slots.1: When unchecked, only slots that currently have equipped items are shown.
strings.help.show_all_slots.2: Enable this to browse every supported equipment slot, including slots that are currently empty.
strings.dav.status.unavailable: Dynamic Armor Variants Extended is unavailable. Browsing will work, but previews and overrides are disabled.
strings.dav.status.too_old: Dynamic Armor Variants Extended 1.3.0 or newer is required. Browsing will work, but previews and overrides are disabled.
strings.dav.status.not_ready: Dynamic Armor Variants Extended is loaded but not ready yet. Previews and overrides are temporarily unavailable.
